procedures.title: Configuration and generic target contract
preconditions: Native qualification executable was built from the selected baseline.
steps: Execute the configuration and platform-contract cases.
Cross-check project, version, and baseline metadata across requirements, procedures, and captured C results.
Cross-build and inspect the ARM ELF separately as required by SQTP.
expected_results: Version/configuration checks and metadata identity pass.
The host platform contract passes.
ARM artifact inspection independently confirms architecture, entry point, retained public APIs, undefined-symbol state, and memory limits.

procedures.title: Boot and cooperative scheduling
preconditions: A fresh controller context is available.
steps: Initialize the controller.
Advance deterministic scheduler ticks across the configured periods.
expected_results: Initialization begins in INIT.
The fixed-period task counts match the documented schedule.

procedures.title: Controller state transitions
preconditions: A fresh controller context is available.
steps: Complete self-test and heartbeat to exercise INIT to OPERATIONAL.
Latch recoverable and critical faults to exercise DEGRADED and SAFE behavior.
Attempt recovery while a critical fault remains.
expected_results: The expected states are reached through the documented rules.
Recovery is rejected while a nonrecoverable fault remains.

procedures.title: Heartbeat sequence and watchdog boundary
preconditions: Self-test has completed in the simulated environment.
steps: Accept a valid heartbeat sequence and repeat it once.
In a fresh context, advance to the 100 ms and 101 ms boundaries without another heartbeat.
expected_results: The fresh sequence is accepted and the repeated sequence is rejected and latched.
The controller remains OPERATIONAL through 100 ms and enters SAFE at 101 ms.

procedures.title: Fault latching and controlled recovery
preconditions: Each case starts with a fresh valid controller context.
steps: Inject a recoverable interface fault.
Request recovery and supply the required self-test/heartbeat sequence.
expected_results: The recoverable fault bit and DEGRADED state are latched.
Recovery clears the allowed mask, returns through INIT, and requires self-test plus a fresh heartbeat before OPERATIONAL.

procedures.title: Resource boundaries and deterministic replay
preconditions: Each case starts from a fresh deterministic context.
steps: Check host structure-size and fixed-queue boundaries.
Replay the same input sequence twice.
expected_results: Host structures remain within their committed bounds and the fixed queue preserves FIFO, full, and empty behavior.
The two normalized outputs are byte-identical.
Linked ARM memory use is checked separately during artifact inspection.

procedures.title: Telemetry content and order
preconditions: Known state, fault, setpoint, SPI-register, and counter values are loaded.
steps: Encode one telemetry record and test its length, sequence, state, fault bytes, and CRC placement.
Inspect the encoder offsets for setpoint, SPI register zero, accepted counters, and rejected counter.
expected_results: The C case passes its representative layout and CRC checks.
Source inspection confirms all remaining required fields occupy the documented deterministic offsets.

procedures.title: UART protocol validity and rejection
preconditions: A fresh output frame and bounded wire buffer are available.
steps: Encode and decode a 64-byte UART payload.
Reject corrupt-CRC, truncated, wrong-marker, wrong-interface-byte, and invalid-interface-enum buffers.
Attempt to encode a 65-byte payload while monitoring caller-owned output sentinels.
expected_results: The valid frame round-trips without field changes.
Every invalid buffer returns its documented error without publishing a decoded frame.
Rejected encode/decode operations preserve caller-owned destinations.

procedures.title: SPI and classic CAN model boundaries
preconditions: Fresh SPI and CAN models are available.
steps: Round-trip a bounded SPI frame, attempt a 33-byte frame, and read/write valid and invalid virtual registers.
Round-trip an eight-byte classic CAN frame and attempt a nine-byte payload and an identifier above 0x7FF.
expected_results: Valid modeled operations succeed.
Invalid SPI lengths/addresses and invalid CAN lengths/identifiers return the documented errors.

procedures.title: Ethernet-style datagram model boundaries
preconditions: A fresh datagram model is available.
steps: Round-trip zero-byte and 256-byte payloads.
Attempt to encode a 257-byte payload.
expected_results: Both valid boundaries round-trip without field changes.
The 257-byte payload is rejected before copying.
